name: Vesperal-Corrie
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs solar wind erosion patterns, stark under a black sky.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built monolithic structures of unknown origin left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
